## ShuYi-Agent v0.5.2

### Highlights

- Removes the backend access-token workflow so local, CNB, and GitHub Pages usage no longer require a token.
- Supports dynamic CNB forwarded backend addresses from GitHub Pages, including bare-domain frontend input and public no-credential CORS preflight handling.
- Adds model configuration actions for backend connection testing, TTS model API testing, and one-click TTS model download/deploy with progress feedback.
- Improves offline/error behavior so disconnected backend failures surface as `ApiRequestError`, while simple document parsing can still fall back to local display behavior.
- Renames user-facing copy from “语句” to “台词” and changes “音频生成” to “生成配音”.
- Fixes role deletion, role voice controls, and long-novel parsing fallback edge cases.
- Updates the frontend branding to use `shuyi-agent-zh.svg` and aligns the header layout.
- Adds CNB/VS Code port-forwarding configuration and removes misleading guessed public backend URLs from logs.

### Deployment Notes

- GitHub Pages is static frontend only; for a temporary CNB backend, fill `https://<PORTS Forwarded Address>/api/v1` in “模型配置 > 后端 API”.
- The backend public API no longer requires browser CORS origin whitelist configuration.
- TTS models are downloaded and started from “模型配置 > 下载并部署”; non-TTS APIs remain available while deployment is running.
